d:
A new diabolical serial killer is stalking the streets. He would secretly take a photo of his victims while following them, then attack and kill his target (usually chinese women between 20 and 30 years old), have his way with their bodies and then photos them in various poses using the victims' own phones, leaving the photos for the victims' loved ones to see.

He would soon be known as ...The Photoshoot Killer

Here are photos of his first victim, 24 year old Geraldine, found on her own phone.

There are also some images from a nearby CCTV showing the killer in his act.
